profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Medtronic
profile.summary: Lead Developer possessing extensive experience developing Microsoft/Linux/QNX (C++/C#.NET/WPF/WinForms) based solutions in surgical robotics, autonomous marine robotics, equities trading, client assets protection, portfolio management/analysis and market data delivery.

positions.title: Senior UI Developer
positions.description:
Lead Developer of the user interface providing the first industrial-grade autonomy and remote-control support for commercial marine vessels utilizing C#.NET/WPF/SevenCs/MySQL/SQL/Kafka technologies
•	Designed/developed support for early warning collision avoidance of AIS/ARPA targets providing graphical alerts/notifications leveraging the autonomous command infrastructure which pilots a vessel in preplanned/routine long duration missions with real-time self-awareness to keep the vessel on plan/course and away from obstacles in accordance with the IMO’s Rules of the Road navigation rules.
•	Designed/developed support for controller/viewer chat functionality utilizing Kafka distributed publish-subscribe messaging
•	Designed/developed enhancements to the direct remote command infrastructure providing remote joystick control of a boat within a 1-kilometer range and giving the operator the flexibility of not being confined to a vessel during its operation.
•	Provide technical support to field technicians, test boat captains, in-house ME/EE, Autonomy and AI Perception engineers dealing with platform enhancements, deployments, and production issues.

positions.title: Prime Services
positions.description:
Lead Developer of a high-touch, mission critical, multi-asset global order management trading platform leveraging C#.NET/WPF/WinForms that is used by 1,200+ equity traders in Global Markets providing real-time transactional execution and legal trading compliance. Responsible for ongoing requirements, on-time platform deliverables, and resolution of production issues.
•	Designed/developed interface/experience optimizations to streamline the current manually intensive execution workflow for swaps involving custom baskets, indexes and exchange-traded funds that exposes traders to the potential for trading errors and booking breaks; improving trading/booking workflow, increasing efficiency and reducing errors.
•	Designed/developed optimized hedge swaps bookings to reduce settlement failures/breaks. With an estimated 1,400 settlement failure breaks saved per week, this optimization resulted in considerable saving of time/effort within settlements and it mitigated the incurring of regulatory fines.
•	Designed/developed support for trade history acquisition that is dynamically driven by user-defined search criteria.
•	Designed/developed support for the detection of trade booking collisions to mitigate downstream settlement anomalies.
•	Designed/developed batch processing services to manage logging output on production servers.
•	Provide technical Level 2 support to traders dealing with platform enhancements, deployments, and production issues.

positions.title: VP - Client Assets Technology
positions.description:
Lead Developer of a GUI platform built from scratch using C#.NET/WPF/WinForms/Java providing firm-wide automation protection of client-owned securities by segregation (Sec Rule 15c3-3); it maximizes intra-day rehypothecation of client collateral, reduces deficits/over-segregations and improves transparency across US, European and Asian business entities.
•	GUI desktop/platform comprises a collection of scope/result pane views of intra-day transactions, portfolio positions, transaction rejections/exclusions, asset selections/constraints of intra-day rehypothecation criteria, clearing house segregation imbalance details. It supports CSV search criteria importing and provides analysis of root cause data anomalies via tooltip support. Additionally, it supports navigation between views of related data, floating window support, exporting data to Excel, grid column freezing/swapping/resizing and multi-level groupings/summaries. 
•	WPF dashboard leveraging the Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM) design pattern to provide global rehypothecation metrics, segregation imbalances, loan value/under-utilized variances, trends and milestone status; multi-series charting is provided using the Microsoft Data Visualization Toolkit.
•	Java middle-tier provides remote services leveraging in-house SOA frameworks for Tibco rendezvous messaging support, Spring IoC to establish configuration bindings, threads/JDBC extensions for DB2 data acquisition and IntelliJ’s built-in JUnit and Code Coverage facilities to test ongoing development.
•	Data security/entitlements infrastructure provides Chinese Wall information barrier protection around client-related data.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Lead Developer of a GUI application using C#.NET/WPF/WinForms Composite (Prism) leveraging the Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM) design pattern that is used by Institutional Credit, Equity and Equity Derivatives sales/trading desks providing flow tracking information/analytics of internal trading strategies/execution that are allied with external client interests.
•	Trade monitoring using grid data and Panopticon graphics of bond trades broken down by sector, rating, yield and maturity.
•	Historical trades/client interest breakdowns and filtering by clients.
•	DevExpress repository editing support, providing improved functionality/ease of use.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Lead Developer of a next-generation C#.NET/WPF/WinForms platform built from scratch, integrating expressWay™ technology providing multi-asset, extremely high-speed trading performance and analytics.
•	Asset View comprising multi-asset panels of Level I/II Montagues providing Price by Levels, Top of Book, Summary, Liquidity, Spread and Depth View displays of daily Bid/Ask offerings with last-sale trading activity; dynamically executes trades via pre-defined strategy template task buttons; incorporates straddle/stacked Equity Put/Call Options views; integrates order tracking cancellation/replacement; supports Reg NMS ISO Qty display of protected quotes and their cumulative quantities; supports MPID color-tracking for TOB vs all Level II Montague related quotes; displays Pink Sheet/Bulletin Board OTC quotes, last-sale prices and volume.
•	Blotter comprising of a Detail, Summary, Positions, and Allocations views displaying staged/placed orders, short/long/closed positions, order allocations; implemented functionality to work/cancel/replace multi-selected staged orders.
•	Allocation Manager handles filled/partially filled orders; implemented support for bulk importing of orders/positions with filtering support by asset, ticket-type, venue, status, symbol, side and level (Firm/Desk/Blotter/User).
•	Hotkey triggering of strategy templated tasks leveraging .NET command bindings and input keyboard gestures.
•	Security Tier Settings governing order placement by tier setting binding, selected security and target venue.
•	Task Builder functionality to manage strategy template tasks by Firm, Desk and User; incorporated support for creating/modifying/deleting tasks; integrated Hotkey triggering and Tier Settings support into task behaviors.
•	SaveAsDefault serialization and Restore Default restoration of key desktop/window attributes.

positions.title: VP - Lead Developer
positions.description:
Lead Developer of a trading application for Institutional Core Equities based on C#.NET/WinForms providing support for single order trade execution, portfolio basket trading, sales order management and trade allocation.
•	GUI-based applets incorporating client order-to-sales aggregation functionality; integrated Infragistics controls and simplified XML-based configuration dependencies.
•	Support for the manual fill of portfolio orders, incorporating automated bulk updates via Excel; integrated support for the incremental modifications of fills to existing sales orders.
•	Product repair/enrichment of inbound FIX/file-based sales orders.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead Developer of the next-generation Portfolio Manager based on C#.NET/WinForms consolidating portfolio management capabilities to allow investment managers to view exposures/holdings, understand the impact of asset allocation and de-risking decisions as well as construct portfolios that align with investment mandates.
•	GUI MDI-desktop providing spreadsheet-like data visualization and aggregation capabilities with analytics/risk metrics; support for portfolio rebalancing, asset allocation management, monitoring of multiple portfolios simultaneously in user-defined views, real-time PnL via market data/pricing feeds using DevExpress, DotNetMagic docking and Dundas charting controls, intranet Web Services, ADO.NET, multi-threading, .NET/COM/Win32 interops, multi-monitor support and SOAP/XML.
•	Support for the integration of Reuters/Bloomberg analytics using DDE and .NET/COM/Win32 interops.
•	Support for trade creation using various methodologies: indices, risk-neutral, weight and duration targets.
•	Support for web-based integration of portfolio holdings to financial news, market summaries and Level I/II analytics.
•	Portfolio management session startup uses Java web-services, ODBC-data sources and data compression practices.

positions.title: Consultant Developer
positions.description: Consultant Developer of a WinForms Equities Derivatives trading system implemented the Model-View-Controller (MVC) design pattern moving business logic to the middle tier to maintain rich/responsive thin clients to traders; utilized MDI GUIs, SAO/CAO .NET remoting strategies, real-time TIB-market data acquisition, multi-threading, SOAP/XML, xcopy and no-touch deployment.

positions.title: VP - Lead Developer & Manager
positions.description:
Development Manager providing technical direction, coordination and mentorship to staff of seven (7) developers.
•	BrokerTec/Garban feed handlers into the New York and London FICC market data production environments. Written in C++ using extensive BrokerTec/Reuters APIs running on Unix/Solaris platforms.
•	Web-based Unix system providing J2EE automation to disable NT, Kerberos, Exchange, SecureID, market data/Bloomberg and mainframe resources of users no longer in the firm. Written in Java using JNI interfaces and COM-backend components.
Lead Developer of large-scale Windows-based solutions for global infrastructure administration, software distribution/installation mechanisms, market data business development and firm-wide integration of 3rd party technologies.
•	Developed Windows MMC snap-ins GUI providing global infrastructure administration of users, groups, printers, machines and project resources plus support for software distribution/installation mechanisms onto client workstations. Written in C++.
•	C#.NET/WinForms application governing decomposition/packaging of in-house/3rd party software using .NET remoting, intranet Web Services, ADO.NET, multi-threading, .NET/COM/Win32 interops, SOAP/XML messaging and xcopy.
•	GSMDAPI (Goldman Sachs Market Data API) encapsulating Reuters market data subscriptions onto TIBCO/Triarch delivery infrastructures to support real-time streaming data demands. Written using C++ and Reuters APIs.

positions.title: Senior Technical Specialist
positions.description: Senior Technical Specialist in the ISG Advanced Tech Group responsible for providing support for risk analysis/management services plus access over the internet to a repository of public/private documentation of legal insurance infringement proceedings to business partners using Citrix/WinFrame technology.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Lead Developer of an enterprise-wide document imaging/workflow automation software designed for high-volume, transaction-oriented applications allowing documents to be scanned, stored on optical disk and routed to PC workstations along user-defined workflows creating a paperless business environment. Written using C++, ODBC, SQL Server DB-Lib, ASPI and Win32 APIs.

positions.title: Staff Programmer
positions.description:
Staff Developer of an award-winning TPF/mainframe automation product written in "C" using OS/2 Presentation, Database and Communications Manager APIs. Designed/developed multi-threaded support for system administration, SQL database transactions and user-security configuration.
Consultant Developer on a major IBM product development effort providing multi-threaded client/server SQL database support and Session Services APIs using OS/2 Presentation/Database Manager APIs and APPC communications.

positions.title: System Design Engineer
positions.description: Lead Developer providing on-line program review formats to aid information management with real-time review/analysis of major contracts. Designed/developed U1100/MAPPER database to store cost/schedule data; support for graphics generation of program review charts and translation of HPGL graphics commands to U1100 network laser printers.

honors.title: Charles River Development User Conference
honors.description: Unveiled the next generation Manager Workbench platform redeveloped using the C#.NET Framework
honors.issuer: Issued by Charles River Development · Jan 2006

honors.title: AIG - SIA Award
honors.description: Unveiled 2 of 5 most notable applications: risk analysis/management services and a public/private repository of legal insurance infringement proceedings.
honors.issuer: Issued by American International Group · Jan 1997

volunteerExperiences.description: Its cross-divisional, team based projects, targeted to assist the homeless, underprivileged children and other marginalized communities in New York hoping to make a positive impact in their lives.

patents.title: Distributed Database Management Over A Network
patents.description: A computer implemented method for handling a request for the retrieval of specified data in a distributed database environment having a plurality of data requestors and a plurality of database servers, each said database servers having data storage associated therewith, said request originating from one of said requestors, said data requestors and said database servers being located at respective nodes of a communications network.
